name: velox-config
description: Understand, review, troubleshoot, and create importable Velox configuration using shared Velox documentation and optional read-only customer GitHub configuration.

interface.longDescription: Use Velox Config to understand existing Velox Flows, actions, scripts, mappings and schedules, or create new importable .CFG configuration. It uses VeloxEDI/velox-ai-info as shared knowledge when GitHub is connected and can optionally inspect one designated customer configuration repository as read-only context. It never writes configuration changes back to GitHub.
defaultPrompt: Create an importable Velox CFG for this integration.
Review this Velox Flow and explain how it works.
